subject.title: Feature: Subscribe to WhatsApp call events (Baileys)

question: Should inbound WhatsApp call activity be agent-visible, and if approved should the first version be transient normalized events or durable per-contact history?
rationale: The dependency event is available, but consuming and exposing it changes the channel's privacy boundary and durable history would add a new sensitive state model; source inspection cannot choose that policy safely.

options.title: Transient opt-in events
options.body: Add a separate default-off inbound-call setting and expose sanitized accepted call activity without retaining contact history.

options.title: Durable contact history
options.body: Design a SQLite-backed per-contact activity model with retention, authorization, migration, and query-tool contracts before implementation.

options.title: Keep message-only context
options.body: Do not consume Baileys call events and leave contact activity limited to accepted message traffic.

recommendation.title: Transient opt-in events
recommendation.body: Add a separate default-off inbound-call setting and expose sanitized accepted call activity without retaining contact history.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across WhatsApp calls, runtime ownership, config, and the issue's stated product boundary.
